intro: Ancient squares and the gateway to the Himalaya. That is Kathmandu in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Kathmandu
paragraphs: Kathmandu (South Asia) is known for its culture, mountain and spiritual experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to November and March to April.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Mountain flight or a trip to Nagarkot

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Short flights from Delhi and other Indian cities.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Add Pokhara for lakes and easy Annapurna views.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Kathmandu?

Short flights from Delhi and other Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Kathmandu?
faq.a: Popular choices: Thamel for travellers; Boudha for calm; Patan for heritage.
